Report mandates (6 report mandates)

Statutory duties that require this agency to publish or file a report, with a City Record filing receipt when that report appears.

  • ◆Mandate · Post on its website a report containing the specified civil immigration detainer information for the preceding twelve-month period ending June 30.
    report · deadline 2017-07-31 · one-time · § 9-205(e) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit a summary of each evaluation to the Mayor and the Council, including specified program information.
    report · deadline: Beginning on March 1, 2016 · annual · § 9-203 · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Provide to the Council and publish on its website an annual report regarding recidivism containing the specified information, compared to previous reporting periods.
    report · deadline: No later than 20 days from January 1 of each year; the first report is due within 20 days of January 1, 2017. · annual · § 9-203(b), (d); § 2 · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Post on its website each year a report containing the specified civil immigration detainer information for the preceding twelve-month period ending June 30.
    report · deadline: no later than June 1 of each year thereafter · annual · § 9-205(e) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Provide to the council and publish on its website a report regarding recidivism and the nature of probation violations.
    report · deadline: Within 15 days of January 15, 2025, and no later than 15 days from June 15 and January 15 thereafter · ongoing · Administrative Code § 9-203(b) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit a summary of each program evaluation to the mayor and the council, and post each summary to the department’s website.
    report · deadline: Within 15 days of January 15, 2025, and no later than 15 days from June 15 and January 15 thereafter · ongoing · Administrative Code § 9-204 · Source law↗
